Loaded as a plain classic <script> tag; defines a global `qrcode` function.
Usage: const qr = qrcode(0, 'M'); qr.addData(url); qr.make();
       host.innerHTML = qr.createSvgTag({ cellSize: 5, margin: 2 });
Used by tools/beauty-contest/ (instructor page: QR of the student join URL).
